faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Medical Consultant post in the Reserve Bank of India is 08-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Consultant position is Rs. 1400 per hour for MBBS holders with up to 20 years of experience, and Rs. 1800 per hour for those with more than 20 years of experience or holding an MD qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India and have a minimum of 2 years of experience in practicing medicine. A Post Graduate Degree in General Medicine is also mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the RBI Medical Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the RBI website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Medical Consultant in the Reserve Bank of India.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Medical Consultant is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which city and state is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 190008.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Interview, Medical Tests, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and download the application form from the official website of the Reserve Bank of India, which is www.rbi.org.in.
